scope: Catalog product dimensions and explicit insert/holder pairing. Cutting recommendations are recorded separately.

dimension_definitions.T: Catalog drilling depth, explicitly shown as T(3xD) or T(4xD). Use this field when screening requested drilling depth.
dimension_definitions.L: Drawing dimension from drill tip to the front shoulder of the cylindrical shank; not the overall tool length and not the drilling-depth limit.
dimension_definitions.L1: Rear cylindrical shank axial length; not usable drilling depth.
dimension_definitions.radial_adjustment: Catalog radial adjustment for lathe setup. Listed as a positive magnitude, not an expressly symmetric +/- allowance.
dimension_definitions.Dmax: Maximum diameter associated with the listed lathe radial adjustment. Do not automatically offer this as rotating-drill capacity.

unconfirmed_fields.question: Need dimensioned bottom profiles for each holder/diameter and exact axial tool-length datum; p139 comparison images do not provide these dimensions.
Confirm permissible adjustment direction, Dmax use, required tool rotation/work rotation arrangement, and whether reduced usable depth / clearance applies when offsetting.
Catalog part and grade columns are separate. Confirm full ordering format if a combined SKU is required; do not invent a hyphenated catalog part.

implementation_notes: First ask nominal hole diameter, requested depth, material, rotating-tool/lathe setup, coolant and machine-side shank acceptance.
For a rotating drill, match catalog D and screen requested depth against T; do not use L or L1 for this screen.
For a stationary lathe drill, keep nominal D and requested adjusted diameter separate, and explain radial adjustment/Dmax as a distinct setup.
Choose the corresponding N9GX model automatically from the selected holder; the same model is used for inner and outer positions.
Brand grade NC2032 is not a second independent choice when this catalog lists only that grade for every N9GX model.
Use feed per revolution for feed-rate conversion. Do not multiply by the inner/outer insert count or by the four indexable edges.
A catalog T screening result cannot by itself set programmed Z, breakthrough overtravel, blind-bottom clearance or tool-length correction.

verification.method: Verified original dimension and insert tables; package PDF pages 3–5 correspond to printed pages 138–140.
